description: This file defines a Flutter widget AppScaffold which provides a bottom navigation bar with four tabs: Dashboard, Transactions, Budgets, and Reports. It manages switching between different screens using an IndexedStack and dynamically updates the selected tab.

classes.name: AppScaffold
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides bottom navigation with four main screens for the finance app.

classes.name: _AppScaffoldState
classes.description: State class managing the current tab index and rendering the Scaffold widget with bottom navigation.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for AppScaffold.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree including Scaffold, IndexedStack, and BottomNavigationBar.
